notes.title: Tower Defense: Infinite War Free-to-Play Event
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Com2us.

We are pleased to announce that Tower Defense: Infinite War will be available for free starting from September 10th. Enjoy the pure thrill of defense as you battle against alien invaders!

Through this transition to free-to-play, we hope that more defense enthusiasts will enjoy our game. We would also like to express our deep gratitude to those who have purchased the game. Thanks to your continuous interest and support, we were able to prepare even better services.

As a token of our appreciation to our existing customers, we have prepared a gift of 30,000 Gold. Please make sure to claim it through your in-game mailbox by September 9th.

We will continue to value your feedback and strive to provide an even better gaming experience. Share your strategies with other players in the community and enjoy the game together!

Thank you.
